description:
Chapter & Chance is a community-focused hobby and gaming hub for Brisbane's tabletop gaming, reading, and creative communities. The business combines curated retail with bookable social and creative experiences, bringing together audiences that are usually served by separate, unconnected venues.
 Our core offering spans four areas: gaming (table hire, board game hire, and hosted D&D/TTRPG sessions), retail (a small, competitively-priced selection of miniatures, paints, and craft supplies), consignment (affordable shelf space for independent authors and local artists, run through a membership model), and hospitality (coffee and a casual seating area, open to anyone whether they're gaming or not). On top of this, the space hosts free in-house workshops and can be hired out to external creators running their own paid workshops or events.

name: Just Support Pty Ltd
description:
Just Support are a Support Work service providing support to individuals with varying disabilities. We are a queer-run organisation that values inclusivity, respect, and empowerment. Our values focus on supporting teens and young people, often in vulnerable situations. Our team builds support around what actually interests our participants—gaming, roleplay games, art, social adventures—because growth happens when people feel seen, valued, and excited about learning.
 
 Our Regulation Station is designed to provide support at events where children and adults can come take a break from the event to reset, recharge and relaunch. The goal of this station is to provide a calming space for event goers to regulate their sensory inputs and allow them to then continue to enjoy the event.
